messages:
Priya (PM): Quick sync: three customers asked for a clear upgrade path for private deploys and VPC handoff docs. Need Q2 plan.
Sam (Eng): Customers want deterministic upgrades, low downtime, and a tiny installer.
Maya (Eng-Infra): Main risk is KV and model artifact state. Two flows: in-place with reversible migrations or side-by-side with traffic cutover.
Jordan (Solutions): Field says short drain window OK if rollback is automated + preflight checks provided for NetOps.
Erin (Network): I'll draft required outbound ports, health endpoints, and an iptables snippet. Some customers insist on strict egress.
Luis (Security): Add TLS cert lifecycle, KMS/HSM notes, and audit-trace obligations.
Priya (PM): Proposed Q2 deliverables: preflight CLI, migrate-kv v0.1, upgrade playbook (in-place + side-by-side + quarantine), VPC handoff doc + terraform sample, compatibility matrix.
Sam (Eng): Migrate tool should support simulate/verify and streaming delta replication. Rollback goal: <15m for minor upgrades.
Maya (Eng-Infra): I'll build a restricted-network test harness and a fast-quarantine node mode so new nodes are held out until KV watermark reached.
Jordan (Solutions): Need a one-page checklist for admins and clear remediation messages on preflight failures.
Erin (Network): Will include terraform peering snippet and healthcheck verification steps (curl, openssl s_client).
Luis (Security): Ensure all actions emit trace IDs to audit logs and include a short threat model for upgrade operations.
BuildBot: CI created pipeline-upgrade-playbook-89, running integration against infra-sim-2.
Priya (PM): Sprint plan: sprint1 preflight + matrix, sprint2 migrate-kv + playbook draft + network docs, sprint3 harness + pilots. Airgap installer scoped but deprioritized unless signaled.
Sam (Eng): Compatibility matrix should include model format, quantization profile, runtime ABI, and runtime minimum version.
Priya (PM): I'll create tickets PD-401..PD-404 and coordinate pilots. Thanks all.
Jordan (Solutions): Thanks team.
Maya (Eng-Infra): Thanks!
